notes: RRB NTPC cutoffs are **zone-wise and post-level-wise** — every Railway Recruitment Board declares its own figures for each pay level, so there is no single national cutoff. The rows below are representative official figures from the recent cycle (CEN 05/2024) to show the realistic ranges; your zone's exact cutoff comes from its own RRB website. Marks shown are **normalized** scores out of 100 (CBT 1) with 40%/30% UR/reserved minimum qualifying baselines.

cutoffs.range_UR: 65–72 typical (zone highs ~84, e.g. RRB Malda UR 84.55)

cbt1.source: Official CBT-1 cutoff PDF (CEN 05/2024) via RRB zone sites; reproduced by Testbook/PrepGrind
cbt1.note: CBT-1 cutoffs vary hugely by zone and pay level — the two example rows bracket the real spread.

final.source: RRB final-result (DV shortlist) notices via QMaths
final.note: Final merit for each post adds CBT-2 + CBAT/typing scores; these rows are the shortlist cutoffs for the document stage.
